candidateObjectiveEnglish: Report windy conditions and an unfinished section, then repeat the report for confirmation.
grammarExplanationEnglish: Use "It is" with time or a weather adjective: "It is 4:00 in the afternoon and it is windy." "There is" introduces one thing: "There is an unfinished section at the back." "To" + base verb can express purpose: "We repeat the plan to confirm."
grammarExplanationFrench: « It is » sert ici à donner l’heure ou à décrire le temps. « There is » introduit un élément : « There is an unfinished section at the back ». « To » + verbe de base peut exprimer le but : « We repeat the plan to confirm ».
